minor.issue: Driver RBAC bypass: user record for chauffeur@logitrak.ch has no driver_id field, so `tx.driver_id (None) != user.driver_id (None)` evaluates False and the driver can read admin-created manual TXs that have no driver_id set. Also affects /my-transactions which returns 0 items instead of Jean Dupont's 18 tx. Root cause: users collection missing driver_id link for chauffeur@logitrak.ch (a drivers doc for Jean Dupont exists but is not referenced from users). Fix suggestion: in seed_admin / login, resolve driver_id from drivers collection by email and attach to user; OR in fuel routes, resolve driver_id server-side by user email when missing.

rca_of_the_issue: Driver RBAC gap RCA: seed_admin creates the driver-role user but does not populate the `driver_id` foreign key on the users document. The drivers collection has a Jean Dupont doc with a linked email but the users doc lacks the FK. Every place that does `user.get('driver_id')` therefore sees None. In /transactions/{id} the equality None != None is False → read allowed; in /my-transactions the None short-circuit returns empty. Reproduction: POST /api/livre/fuel/transactions as admin with only vehicle_id (no driver_id), then GET /transactions/{id} as chauffeur → 200 instead of 403. Fix: populate user.driver_id at seed/login time by matching drivers.email == users.email within the tenant.
